label: Philanthropy, nonprofit, and policy-institutions estate
domain: foundations, charities, think tanks, fiscal sponsors, grants, boards, donors, and policy-program institutions
scope: Tax-exempt and charitable organizations, private foundations, think tanks, fiscal sponsors, donor-advised and grantmaking vehicles, board and officer rosters, grants, related organizations, program-service activity, and policy-facing partnerships. The estate preserves EIN or charity-number identity, filing years, missing returns, grants, board terms, and related-party schedules.

asset_refs.role: bounded frontier survey and acquisition preparation

boundary: Board service, a grant, fiscal sponsorship, or shared donor is a typed institutional fact only. It does not establish direction, agreement, control, or policy influence.

next_acquisition.operation: freeze organization denominators and join returns, grants, boards, related organizations, and policy programs by exact identifiers and years
next_acquisition.decisive_output: organization-year ledger of status, returns, officers, grants, related entities, fiscal sponsorship, programs, and explicit nonfiling or no-grant rows
